newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB says adds liquidity to counter franc strength.
newsitem.headline: SNB says adds liquidity to counter franc strength.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) said the recent upward pressure on the Swiss franc was without any fundamental reason and the SNB had reacted by significantly adding liquidity to the money markets.
"This policy will be consequently continued," the SNB said in a statement.
The SNB has frequently said that it would counter any "unrealistic appreciation" of the Swiss franc due to developments connected with European currencies, the SNB said.
"The upward pressure seen recently has no fundamental basis," the SNB added.
